questions.question:
In the following question, select the related word from the given alternatives.

**Watt : Power :: Pascal : ?**
questions.solution:
The logic follows here is:

Watt : Power → Watt is SI unit of Power.

Similarly,

Pascal : ? → Pascal is SI unit of Pressure.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**

questions.question:
In the following question, select the related word from the given alternatives.

**Mekong : Tibet :: Amazon : ?**
questions.solution:
The logic follows here, 

Peru, because the Mekong River originates in Tibet, similarly the Amazon River originates in the Andes mountains, primarily in Peru, making Peru the analogous origin point for the Amazon

**Mekong : Tibet (Origin) :: Amazon : Peru (Origin)**

questions.question: Identify the odd one: **2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13, 17, 20**
questions.solution:
The logic follows here, 

 
• 2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13, 17 → all are prime numbers
 
• 20 → not a prime number (it is composite)
 
• 20 is odd one.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**

questions.question: Which of the following is the odd one out?
questions.solution:
The logic follows here,

Option 1. 2, 3, 5 → all are prime numbers

Option 2. 11, 13, 17 → all are prime numbers

**Option 3. 4, 6, 8 → all are composite numbers**

Option 4. 7, 19, 23 → all are prime numbers

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**

questions.question: In each of the following questions, a group of three numbers/symbols is given in each option. Identify the group that does NOT follow the same pattern as the others.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/62e9565502c2bf8a780d974d2695f2d031f340f07bf716f11cc44d747f7786f1.png] **
 

 
 

 **Options**
 **Letter pattern**
 **Number pattern**
 **Symbol pattern**
 
 

 (1)
 A → B → C
 1 → 2 → 3
 @, #, $ (All Unique)
 
 

 (2)
 D → E → F
 4 → 5 → 6
 %, ^, & (All Unique)
 
 

 (3)
 G → H → I
 7 → 8 → 9
 *, (, ) (All Unique)
 
 

 (4)
 J → K → L
 10 → 11 → 12
 _, @, @ (Repetitive)
 
 

Option 4** is the different one because it breaks the symbol progression. While the letters (J, K, L) and numbers (10, 11, 12) follow the established pattern, the **symbol "@" is repeated** in the second and third groups (**K11@** and **L12@**). 

Hence, the correct answer is “**Option 4**”.

questions.question: A man said, "My mother's husband's only son is the father of your sister's brother." How is the man related to you?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/153c6a6e313de03f2911e6352e768c319ce48bd8d9b10cf6c7d58c07f604979a.png] 

Step-by-step Relationship Analysis:

Breakdown the statement made by the man: "My mother's husband's only son is the father of your sister's brother."

 
• "My mother's husband" refers to the man's Father.
 
• "Father's only son" refers to the man himself (the speaker).
 
• "Your sister's brother" refers to your Brother (or you, if you are male).
 
• Now, replace the parts in the sentence: "I (the man) am the father of your Brother."

Consolidated Family Structure:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/34fb95df85642e491dd0a0e4c72ccfa97338550b5122a0af1893a1b75b5e0855.png] 

If the man is the father of your brother, he must also be your father.

Thus, the man is your Father.

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option 2"**
